d:
“Koi Haseena Jab Rooth Jaati Hai” is one of the most popular and cheerful tracks from the legendary film Sholay (1975), a movie that redefined Indian cinema. Sung with unmatched charm by Kishore Kumar, composed by R. D. Burman, and penned by Anand Bakshi, this song beautifully portrays Dharmendra’s playful attempts to win back Hema Malini’s heart.
